quick_skim.title: LLM-Augmented Bayesian Optimization with Adaptive Policies for Chiplet Design Space Exploration
quick_skim.abstract: Chiplet technology is a key approach for extending Moore's Law. However, its design process is constrained by two primary challenges: the scarcity of early-stage platforms for rapidly evaluating chiplet-based heterogeneous systems, and the complex relationships between design parameters and optimization metrics. To address these challenges, we propose a synergistic framework that integrates a Large Language Model (LLM) with Bayesian Optimization (BO), enabling architectural-level simulation and automated optimization for the 2.5D/3D CPU-GPU heterogeneous chiplets. We extend the open-source chiplet simulator to evaluate 3D designs by supporting graph topologies. Further, to enhance the exploration efficiency of BO, we introduce an LLM that generates high-quality policies to guide the optimization process, enabled by our proposed adaptive directional policy reasoning (ADPR) and an exploration gain-aware fine-tuning method. Finally, we use the policy-guided BO to perform an automated and efficient exploration of the complex chiplet design space. Experiments on 2.5D and 3D chiplet reveal that our framework improves design space exploration efficiency.
quick_skim.llm_evidence_en: 2.5D/3D chiplet heterogeneous integration and automated optimization
quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: Chiplet design suffers from scarce early-stage platforms and complex parameter-metric relations. This work integrates an LLM with Bayesian optimization and extends an open chiplet simulator to support 2.5D/3D graph topologies, enabling automated architectural-level exploration of heterogeneous chiplets.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 芯粒设计面临早期评估平台稀缺以及设计参数与优化指标关系复杂两大难题。本文提出将大语言模型与贝叶斯优化融合的框架，并扩展开源芯粒仿真器以支持图拓扑，从而对2.5D/3D CPU-GPU异构芯粒进行架构级仿真与自动优化。通过引入自适应策略提升贝叶斯优化的探索效率，该工作为芯粒异构集成设计空间探索提供了可复用的自动化方法。
